note: Bangladesh Bank's own site (bb.org.bd annual report index) returns "Request Rejected" to automated readers, so the auditors' report naming the firms could not be reached. The Bangladesh Bank Order 1972 chapter on accounts (bdlaws.minlaw.gov.bd/act-415/act-chapter-print-698.html) only requires the Bank to send the Government its annual accounts "certified by the Auditors" within two months (Article 40(2)), signed by the Governor, a Deputy Governor and the Chief Accounting Officer, for publication in the official Gazette; that chapter does not say who appoints the auditors and does not mention the Comptroller and Auditor-General. No firm can be named without fabrication.

bcrp.gob.pe is behind Imperva/Incapsula bot protection; a direct fetch of the BCRP's published audit report PDF (docs/Transparencia/informes/informes-de-auditoria-2025-2.pdf) returned only the bot-check page. No alternative mirror of the audited statements or of the Ley Organica's audit article was read, so neither the firm nor the appointing body can be stated.

The Central Bank of the UAE Annual Report 2025 (centralbank.ae/media/pjimtxfq/annual-report-2025-en.pdf) was read in three windows. Section 14.1 states only that "The financial statements are audited by independent external auditor appointed by the Board" and that the auditor gave an unqualified opinion for the year ended 31 December 2025; section 14.2 prints the balance sheet and highlights but no independent auditor's report, so the firm is not named in the document. Recordable fact if useful: the external auditor is appointed by the Board (public-body/private split unknown).

boj.org.jm returned a client error for the 2025 annual report page. A third-party mirror of the Bank of Jamaica Annual Report 2022 (moneylaundering.com) was read in three windows: the transmittal letter cites subsection 44(1) of the Bank of Jamaica Act, 1960 and says the accounts were "duly certified by the auditors", and the contents list an "Audited Financial Statements" section, but that section's text is not in the mirrored file, so the auditor (Auditor General or a firm) cannot be named.
